title: mason canonical types
description: The authoritative shapes mason puts on the wire, mirroring mortar's serde output (server/crates/mortar-core/src/model.rs, error.rs, algo/cursor.rs). Field naming is camelCase throughout. Null and absent are distinct and load-bearing: a field that is always present but may be empty is nullable; a field mortar skips when empty is optional. The exact bytes are pinned by server/crates/mortar-core/tests/fixtures/contract.json and checked from both sides. See .specs/06-wire-contract.md.

Did.description: An atproto decentralised identifier. mason reads did:plc and did:web.

Handle.description: A Bluesky handle, lowercased. Display data and a request parameter; never a key.

AtUri.description: An AT-URI, at://<did>/<collection>/<rkey>. Every brick id is one, copied verbatim from upstream.

Timestamp.description: An RFC3339 timestamp. Author-supplied and therefore untrusted: an unparseable value, or one more than 600 seconds in the future, is treated as stale and never admitted.

HttpUrl.description: A URL safe to place in an anchor. Only http and https survive sources::util::is_http_url; a rejected URL becomes an empty string rather than being dropped.

AspectRatio.description: Intrinsic dimensions, used to reserve space before an image or video loads.

Author.description: The author of a brick, denormalised onto every brick because the wire carries nothing else.

Blur.description: Present only when a soft-warn label covers a brick's media behind a reveal. Anything in the hidden tier is dropped upstream, so a blurred brick can always be revealed.

label.description: The label that triggered the cover.

ImageEmbed.description: One image on a post brick. src is the AppView's thumb URL.

ExternalEmbed.description: A link preview carried by a post, rendered inside the card.

Publication.description: The site.standard.publication a blog document belongs to. icon is modelled but never populated: the publication record read asks only for name and url.

CaptionTrack.description: A WebVTT caption track. Modelled end to end and rendered by the player, but no upstream carries caption data today, so the list is empty on every brick.

PostBrick.description: A Bluesky post that is not a native video.

url.description: The post on bsky.app. Rewritten client-side to the reader's chosen atmosphere client.

blur.description: Absent, not null, when there is nothing to cover.

BlogBrick.description: A site.standard.document from an author's own repo. Metadata and a link out only: the lexicon's content union is platform-specific and is never parsed.

url.description: The publication URL joined with the document path. Empty when the result is not an http(s) URL.

coverImage.description: A blob URL on the author's PDS.

VideoSource.description: Which network a video brick came from.

VideoBrick.description: Three things share this shape, distinguished by source and live: a Bluesky clip, an archived Streamplace stream, and a stream happening right now. All three are HLS, so one player handles them.

url.description: Where a viewer goes to watch at the source: bsky.app, or a stream.place watch page.

live.description: Streamplace only: this stream is happening right now. The only brick exempt from the age window, and the only one that jumps the mixer's kind lottery.

viewerCount.description: Live only. It is also the engagement signal for a live brick.

activity.description: What the streamer says they are doing.

captions.description: Absent, not empty, today: mortar skips serialising an empty list.

blur.description: Only ever set on native Bluesky videos.

Brick.description: One card on the wall. An internally-tagged union on kind, so the client receives a discriminated union.

FeedResponse.description: One page of the wall. The response body of GET /api/feed in both build modes.

cursor.description: Null when the wall has no more bricks: the fill is over, no extension wave is in flight, and the follow graph is spent.

warming.description: Present only on a preview response: whether more bricks are still arriving. The client polls and reflows the first screen while this is true, then freezes it.

Cursor.description: The opaque pagination cursor as it appears on the wire: base64url with no padding, wrapping the JSON of CursorPayload. Attacker-writable, so a value that fails to decode yields a fresh wall rather than an error.

CursorPayload.description: What a decoded cursor carries. Engine-internal: the client never inspects it.

snapshot.description: The snapshot cache key, <mode-tag>-<16 hex>. Written on every cursor and currently never read back: handle_feed recomputes the id from DID, seed and mode.

seed.description: The seed for the cohort shuffle and the mixer's jitter. Carrying it is what lets an evicted snapshot rebuild deterministically mid-scroll.

offset.description: The next item offset within the snapshot's wall.

FeedMode.description: The named walls a feed request can ask for via ?mode=. Absent, or anything unrecognised, is the default full wall.

FeedIntent.description: A feed request's role in the warm-then-commit first screen, via ?intent=. Absent is a normal committed page.

MortarErrorCode.description: The machine codes mortar itself emits. The web classifies on these, so they are wire contract rather than cosmetics. The web adds its own out-of-band codes ("wasm", "unknown") for failures that never reached mortar, which is why ErrorEnvelope.error stays a plain string.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The one error shape mortar emits in both build modes. The native server sends it as a JSON body with the status on the response line; the wasm build throws it as a JSON string with the status in-band, because at that point there is no HTTP layer to carry it.

error.description: A machine code. Usually a MortarErrorCode; the web may also produce "wasm" or "unknown".

message.description: Human-readable detail. Display only, never matched on.

status.description: Present only on the wasm channel.
